newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Miss England wins Miss Europe 1996 in Albania.
newsitem.headline: Miss England wins Miss Europe 1996 in Albania.

text.p: Miss England, fashion model Marie-Claire Harrison, won the Miss Europe '96 beauty contest in Tirana on Saturday. Miss Belarus, Yelena Shcherbak, placed second and Miss Israel, Kim Rasliakova, was third.
Harrison, 23, the 49th Miss Europe, won $20,000 and will take home a traditional costume donated by Tirana City Hall.
Born in the northern England town of Clitheroe, Lancashire, Harrison listed her hobbies as acting, water sports and eating cheese and pasta.
The contest, featuring 35 contestants, took place in Albania's Palace of Congresses, a huge concrete monolith built in the communist era.
Miss Europe 1995, Monika Zidkova of the Czech Republic, crowned Harrison, who cried as she accepted the coveted beauty award.
The pageant is the first of its kind in Albania, where a prudish former communist government once spurned gambling, television game shows and rock music as capitalist excess.
